examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Event Dispatch Strategy to FORWARD_COMPETITION
examples.description: In this example, clicking and dragging in the blank area below the List component causes the List component to scroll. The Button component still responds to onClick events.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Event Dispatch Strategy to FORWARD
examples.description: In this example, clicking and dragging in the blank area below the List component causes the List component to scroll. The Button component does not respond to onClick events.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Event Dispatch Strategy to DEFAULT
examples.description: In this example, clicking and dragging in the blank area below the List component does not cause the List component to scroll. The Button component still responds to onClick events.
